characters.description: Commander of the Ankh-Morpork City Watch and Duke of Ankh, a powerful man who has never stopped thinking of himself as a copper on the street. Married to Lady Sybil, who is about to give birth, he is defined by the law and by hard memories of a poorer, more brutal city.
characters.name: Samuel Vimes

characters.description: A cheerful, casually vicious killer whom Vimes is hunting through the city. He murders without hesitation or remorse and treats it all as a great joke, which makes him more dangerous than any calculating criminal.
characters.name: Carcer

characters.description: A raw young lance-constable in the Night Watch of an earlier, harsher Ankh-Morpork: naive, idealistic, and eager to do right in a force riddled with graft. He is Vimes's own younger self.
characters.name: Young Sam Vimes

characters.description: A younger, leaner version of the future sergeant, here a steady junior watchman in the old Night Watch, already inclined to caution and a quiet life.
characters.name: Fred Colon

characters.description: Here a scrawny, light-fingered street child who runs errands and picks pockets around the edges of the Watch, a young version of the future corporal.
characters.name: Nobby Nobbs

characters.description: An earnest, hot-blooded young revolutionary who paints slogans and dreams of a fairer city, throwing himself into the coming uprising with more passion than sense.
characters.name: Reg Shoe

characters.description: A watchful, precise young student of the Assassins' Guild, observing the city's unrest with detached, calculating interest. He is the young Havelock Vetinari.
characters.name: Havelock Vetinari

characters.description: The head of the tyrant's secret police, the Unmentionables, a cold and methodical zealot who believes crime can be read in the measurements of a person's body and who uses torture as routine procedure.
characters.name: Findthee Swing

characters.description: The Patrician of this earlier Ankh-Morpork, a paranoid and unstable tyrant whose cruelty and fear are pushing the city toward open revolt.
characters.name: Lord Winder

characters.description: An unassuming old man with a broom who turns up where he is least expected. He is in truth a monk of an order devoted to keeping history flowing along its proper course.
characters.name: Lu-Tze

characters.description: A resourceful back-street doctor, unlicensed and unsentimental, who treats the poor and the injured without asking too many questions.
characters.name: Dr Lawn
